nodes.label: Neon Auth Managed Better Auth Architecture
nodes.norm_label: neon auth managed better auth architecture
nodes.rationale: Isolates auth tables in neon_auth schema, synchronizing to public User table via authUserId to keep Prisma schema clean and avoid adapter table bloat.

nodes.label: Neon Auth Trusted Domains Authorization
nodes.rationale: Neon Auth enforces origin authorization on cookies and OAuth redirects, requiring custom domains to be explicitly registered in trusted domains.

nodes.label: ResumeDocument Versioned JSON Schema
nodes.rationale: Use versioned JSON schema with cryptographic stable IDs on repeatable entries to prevent UI state tearing during list reordering and deletions.

nodes.label: Debounced In-Flight Queue Autosave Architecture
nodes.rationale: Uses 1.2s debounce with single in-flight save and queued snapshot to prevent database saturation and race conditions while validating Zod schemas before persistence.

nodes.label: Core Architecture and Security Invariants
nodes.rationale: Enforce strict session-scoped authorization, fixed Zod-validated AI actions, privacy-by-design, server-only secrets, and decouple core editing and PDF export from AI availability.

nodes.label: Session Authorization and Privacy Framework
nodes.rationale: Strict server-side session ownership checks on every read and mutation; sensitive data transmitted ephemerally without storing full prompts or resumes in logs.

nodes.label: Core Product Philosophy
nodes.rationale: Guarantees always-free watermark-free export, human-in-the-loop AI review, fault-tolerant core editing independent of AI outages, and privacy-by-design.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 Architectural Conventions
nodes.rationale: Adopt Next.js 16 Proxy over middleware, enforce async request APIs inside Suspense boundaries, and utilize Turbopack cacheComponents for performance.

nodes.label: BYOK Gemini AI Architecture
nodes.rationale: Users provide their own Google AI Studio Gemini API key stored strictly in browser localStorage, eliminating backend API costs and allowing full 15 RPM free-tier quota.

nodes.label: Zero-Cost Free-Tier Strategy
nodes.rationale: Leverage Vercel Hobby, Neon Postgres serverless free tier, and Google Gemini free tier to build and host a portfolio-grade web app at zero operational cost.
